EmailTemplate.description: Email Template to Notify ESG Team for Approval of Sustainability Scorecard Record
EmailTemplate.name: NZC Sustainability Scorecard Input Approval
EmailTemplate.subject: Approval Request of Sustainability Scorecard Input Record {!SustainabilityScorecard.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!User.FirstName},
Please be informed that the Sustainability Scorecard record {!SustainabilityScorecard.Name} has been updated. Please review the record and take the necessary actions.
Thanks, Net Zero Team
